title: Quantitative $Γ$-Convergence: A Variational Extrapolation Framework
summary: This paper introduces a new extrapolation framework within the Calculus of Variations. We develop a robust quantitative theory of the $Γ$-convergence approach of De Giorgi by combining it with Gagliardo's work on relative completions in interpolation theory. A central new tool is the extrapolation of \emph{variational $K$-functionals}, which associates to an arbitrary family of functionals a dynamic penalty method that simultaneously characterizes their $Γ$-limits and yields explicit rates of convergence for minimizers. As a technical foundation we prove compactness extrapolation theorems…
